page.overview:
Who is Castavelli?

The Beaujelois was the Tilean mercenaries' transport, a fat-bottomed cog. Both it and the Destrier being of Tilean make.

Castavelli had become one of Tilea’s most celebrated heroes since his return from the green hell of Lustria. This is no surprise as all the men who’d returned from that particular route are glorified.

According to the Tilean version of events, Castavelli had been the leader of the expedition. His courage had inspired everybody else but some say that things were gone differently - and they're right to believe so.

The scores of Tileans aboard his ship are in stark contrast to the stained and stitched rags that served most of their comrades for uniforms. The Tileans wore luxuriantly coloured and elegantly tailored fabrics. Even the poorest of them had a wide, well-tooled leather sash upon which to hang a rapier, and a broad-brimmed slouch hat forested with long white feathers.
